source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies fixed-point monotone LR testing and its canonical Brownian-plus-parabola GCM slope-energy limit, including the constrained slope construction; it does not state a growing-domain excursion or Poisson maximum theorem.
The paper studies increasing-interval extremes of the stationary Brownian-parabolic argmax displacement process and its absolute value, not constrained-versus-unconstrained GCM LR energy.

The article characterizes Poisson or compound-Poisson limits for stationary-sequence exceedance point processes under dependence conditions; it does not verify such conditions for the proposed continuous LR-energy field.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 40(3), 2012 author-deposited journal article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives a Gumbel limit for the supremum norm error of Grenander-type estimators on interior subintervals, rather than an LR-energy-field maximum.

The paper supplies general consistency and pointwise weak-convergence conditions for generalized Grenander-type estimators, including data-dependent domain transformations, not a continuum LR extreme-value theorem.

The article develops tuning-free causal isotonic regression, irregular limit theory, and potential doubly robust inference; the inspected publication does not claim simultaneous LR Gumbel calibration.

source_verification_receipts.version: JASA accepted/in-press 2026; theorem text corroborated against arXiv:2508.08415v1 because the final journal text was not publicly accessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible author version explicitly limits the LR-type confidence interval to a fixed point of a monotonic continuous-treatment curve, uses a doubly robust nuisance-product remainder, and includes cross-fitting; no formula-level mismatch is asserted for the inaccessible journal version.
The paper proposes debiased local-linear covariate-adjusted regression inference and establishes asymptotically valid uniform confidence bands through empirical-process supremum approximation.

The preprint uses minimum-variance weighting and local-linear estimation, derives uniform Bahadur representations, and constructs bootstrap uniform bands; it is a smoothing-based alternative rather than the stated LR-energy result.
The article develops doubly robust nonparametric continuous-treatment estimation and illustrates it with nurse staffing and hospital readmissions, supporting the named application consumer.
